text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I came over for lunch... I spotted 
the same two familiar faces again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now then! Permission to cook here has been 
secured. Let us begin at once!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
All right! Sandwich making, let's 
definitely make it a success this time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! For I have properly bought my 
true feelings in ingredient form!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah, look at all the colorful 
vegetables...! You picked lots of green 
and yellow vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Everyone was worried about their lack 
of vegetables! To run energetically, good 
health is paramount!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words! A highly nutritious 
sandwich! That is precisely the dish we 
should strive for!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curious to see how their rematch would go, 
I decided to watch from a nearby seat.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Once the eggs are mixed... oil!! Pouring 
plenty of oil in here—...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No-no! Hold on, Bakushin O-san. The recipe 
says "a small amount"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oops, quite right! Any more would be a 
calorie overload!! I shall pour just a 
balanced dash~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And cook for 5 minutes! Yes! With 
high-heat fire—...!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: S-Stop right there, Bakushin O-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand completely! What must 
burn right now is my heart!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For 5 full minutes, I shall channel my 
appreciative feelings into it~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah!! To everyone always working 
hard! Thank you for your service!! Let us 
continue to... bakushin on~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haah... haah... It is! Fin! Ished!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Waaaah~! It looks delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Of course it does! After all, I am 
the Class President!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You really are a wonderful Class 
President! I'm sure everyone will be 
thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My my~! Is that so? It truly is, isn't 
it~! Indeed it is~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone must be eagerly awaiting this! 
Heh, I can practically hear their voices 
right now!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh! There is no time to waste! For 
everyone's sake, I must go hand these out 
immediately!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Baaakuuushiiin Bakushiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah! P-P-P-Please waaaaait!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
All the boxed lunches you worked so hard 
on will get ruined~!
